name: v1.0.0-beta-6
body:
## What's Changed
* cuDNN convolution / U-Net and cuFFT transforms on the CUDA backend by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/3
* perf(cuda): close the H200 gaps vs PyTorch (cuDNN graph API, pinned transfers) + fp16/bf16 buffers by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/4
* fix: std::alloc size class 33 read past the cache tables by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/5
* perf: CPU SIMD/threads for std/dsp and std/ml; float DSP; vendor BLAS by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/6
* perf(std): slab allocator, quarantine byte budget, faster Vec/HashMap, half-spectrum rFFT, arena FeatureMaps by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/7
* feat(std/ml): flash and linear attention on ROCm by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/9
* perf(std/ml): MPS bf16 decode/flash/linear attention, faster RMSNorm and GEMV by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/8
* feat(cuda): flash and linear attention (cuDNN SDPA, tensor-core kernels) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/11
* perf(cuda): faster head-dim-128 linear and fp32 flash attention by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/12
* fix(std): panic/log print through stderr_compat.h by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/10
* perf(std/ml): MPS flash attention on simdgroup matrices, chunk-parallel linear attention, CUDA/ROCm-compatible API by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/13
* perf(std/ml): ROCm attention on matrix cores (MFMA) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/14
* perf(std/ml): 8-simdgroup MPS flash attention threadgroups where they win by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/15
* safeguard: honor $SAFEC and key the std archive cache on the compiler by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/16
* perf(std/dsp): Accelerate vDSP for FIR on Apple; fix fft.sc linking on macOS by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/17
* feat(std/ml): ROCm decode ops (half GEMV, RMSNorm, GELU); gpu_mps links off Apple by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/18
* feat(std/ml): CPU half_gemv; tensor_blas/tensor_vdsp link on every platform by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/19
* std/ml CUDA: decode ops from the Gemma 4 engine (half GEMV, RMSNorm, GELU, split-KV attention) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/20
* perf(std/ml): Apple Silicon half_gemv, half_gemv_batch, P-core pool by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/21
* fix(std/sched): wait out connect() in the http and websocket clients (macOS) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/22
* std/http: bound connect and handshake time in HTTP/WebSocket clients by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/23
* std/ml: residual/pooling, Mamba SSM, training stack, generative models, RL, LoRA/QLoRA by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/24
* fix(std): panic/log print through stderr_compat.h by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/26
* std/ml: trainable convnets; fp16/bf16 mixed precision on CPU, ROCm and CUDA by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/27
* std/ml CUDA: faster mixed-precision ops and 16-bit convolutions by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/28
* std: faster CPU training (sgemm packs once per call, vectorized optimizer) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/29
* feat(safeguard): prebuilt and local library dependencies; fix [[dependencies]] parsing by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/31
* std/ml: device-resident training on ROCm (nn_rocm.h) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/30
* std/ml nn_rocm: MIOpen convolutions, fused passes, fp16/bf16 training by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/32
* std: audit outside std/ml — bug fixes, convention fixes, broader tests by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/33
* std/ml: one training interface over CPU and ROCm (traits), backend picked at build time by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/34
* std/ml: operations on stateful types are methods by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/35
* std: AES-GCM TLS records, real MMU formats, chip-generic HAL, verified GUI backends by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/36
* Trait composition and bounded generic structs; std/ml models as composed traits by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/37
* std/ml: autograd as methods (Tensor::backward / zero_grad, Autograd state) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/38
* feat(compiler): static methods, keyword method names, return-type inference by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/39
* feat(compiler): methods with their own type parameters by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/40
* std/ml: static-method constructors; single-tensor ops as methods by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/41
* compiler: static calls through a type parameter; generic functions as values by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/42
* std/ml: generic DenseTensor<E>; HalfTensor/BF16Tensor with autograd by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/44
* std: methods, static constructors and composed traits by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/45
* fix(compiler): struct-body declarations, trait method shapes, newtype if const, pointer inference by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/43
* ml/mps: typed MpsBuf, GPU Mlp training, const-pointer global and dispatch fixes by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/46
* ml: train on ROCm, CUDA and Metal through tensor devices; fp16/bf16, SparseTensor by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/47
* ml: trainable attention and transformers on tensor devices; fused attention kernels by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/48
* ml/device_cuda: cuDNN graph plans for device convolutions; first H200 run by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/49
* ml/device: every kernel on the Metal GPU from the shared kernel source; macOS link fix by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/50


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/compare/v1.0.0-beta-5...v1.0.0-beta-6
tag_message:
SafeC 1.0.0-beta-6

- Compiler: static methods, methods with their own type parameters,
  trait method shapes and bounds, generic functions as values, static
  calls through a type parameter, and stricter declaration checking
- std: constructors as static methods, struct operations as methods,
  composed single-capability traits (Allocator, Resettable, TaskRunner,
  Reader / Writer), and a std audit
- std::ml: train on ROCm, CUDA and Metal through tensor devices
  (device.h) with fp16 / bf16 precision; generic DenseTensor and
  SparseTensor; trainable attention and transformers with fused kernels;
  convnets, autoencoders, GANs, RL, SSM / Mamba, LoRA / QLoRA, norms and
  more optimizers
- GPU backends: CUDA (cuBLAS, cuDNN graph plans, cuFFT), flash / linear /
  split-KV decode attention, decode GEMV / RMSNorm / GELU, mixed-precision
  training ops; ROCm MFMA attention; Metal attention and device training
- net: connect() timeouts in the HTTP and WebSocket clients

name: v1.0.0-beta-5
tag_message:
SafeC 1.0.0-beta-5

- Release binaries link LLVM statically (beta-4's Linux safec needed
  libLLVM.so.21.1 installed)
- install.sh / install.ps1 find clang >= 21 and set SAFEC_CLANG; the
  Windows installer now finds pre-releases
- README updated for current flags, targets and safety rules

name: v1.0.0-beta-4
body:
## What's Changed
* Honor volatile on variables, fields and pointee types by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/1
* Target arch macros + WebAssembly targets (wasm32/wasm64) by @minjaekimartist in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/2

## New Contributors
* @minjaekimartist made their first contribution in https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/safec-org/SafeC/commits/v1.0.0-beta-4
tag_message:
SafeC 1.0.0-beta-4

- Generic, void*-free standard library; stdlib test suites
- Bare-metal targets (x86, x86_64, aarch32/64, Cortex-M, RV32/64) and
  WebAssembly (wasm32/wasm64, export_name/import attributes)
- ROCm/HIP ML backend with custom kernels
- volatile honored on variables, fields, pointee types, &x, typedefs
- Raw pointers are unsafe-only; (?&T)p for checked conversion
- noalias miscompile fixed; strict aliasing (TBAA), --no-strict-aliasing
- Predefined target architecture macros; LLVM 21-23
